company_fit.quote: Whether the setting is a bathroom, a kitchen splashback or an exterior wall, natural stone brings a texture that keeps catching the light differently as the day moves on.
We began with slate and terracotta, rooted in a respect for traditional craftsmanship and a belief in authenticity.
Our story began in Devizes in 1989 as Artisans of Devizes, built on a passion for natural stone and enduring craftsmanship.

Handmade ceramics, marble and limestone, glass, terracotta, delicate mosaics and large-format porcelain all find a place within our range.
Marble and limestone bring depth, veining and a coolness that suits bathrooms particularly well, while terracotta and glazed brick bring warmth instead.
